description: Find travel eSIM data plans for a destination from every provider esimdata tracks, ranked neutrally by price (or price per GB, or validity). Filter by trip length, data, unlimited, needs (hotspot, 5G, phone number, top-up, no ID check) and budget. Each result has a buy_url to the provider's page and the time the price was checked.

also_countries.description: More destinations on the same trip; only plans covering all of them are returned.

country.description: Destination: English name ("Japan"), ISO code ("JP") or common alias ("UK").

days.description: Trip length: the plan must last at least this many days.

gb.description: Data needed in GB (unlimited plans always qualify).

needs.description: Plans must state these; plans that don't say are left out.

single_country_only.description: Leave out regional and global plans.

unlimited.description: true = unlimited plans only, false = no unlimited plans.

name: search_plans
title: Search travel eSIM plans
